title: Claude enclave agent exits 1 before initialization with an invalid launch option
symptoms: Claude enclave agent exit 1 before stream initialization
classification unknown-option or invalid-option-value in enclave startup diagnostics
conditions: The Claude enclave fails before initialization, not by timeout
Older code passed --permission-prompts auto, which Claude Code 2.1.280 rejects, and omitted unattended shell/file approvals
Only the bounded classification is retained; raw stderr, prompts and model output are not
rootCause: The launch policy used a permission-prompts value rejected by the installed Claude Code CLI and the production environment builder did not supply the fixed unattended approvals, so the process failed at argument parsing.

probe.expect: Read the finite Claude session classification (unknown-option, invalid-option-value, missing-option-value, invalid-settings, invalid-mcp-config or unknown). A classification identifies a configuration class, not the offending value; absence is unknown, not success.

action: Use source whose trusted child-environment builder fixes the policy (host default; none with a closed Read/Write/Edit/Bash/Glob/Grep allowlist for unattended runs). Do not allow request-controlled policy or broad environment passthrough. Hosted acceptance remains separate.
